tools.description: Creates a real event on the calendar immediately and, by default, emails an invitation to every attendee listed. No confirmation step.

attendees.description: Attendee email addresses. Adding someone sends them a real invitation immediately.

calendarId.description: Calendar id, e.g. "you@gmail.com". Defaults to "primary", the main calendar.

description.description: Longer event notes, shown in the event detail view.

location.description: Free-text location, e.g. an address or a room name.

sendUpdates.description: Who Google emails about the change. Defaults to "all".

start.description: Set dateTime for a timed event, or date for an all-day one.

date.description: YYYY-MM-DD for an all-day event; an all-day end date is exclusive. Use this or dateTime, never both.

dateTime.description: RFC 3339 timestamp for a timed event, e.g. "2026-08-01T14:30:00-04:00". Use this or date, never both.

timeZone.description: IANA time zone name, e.g. "America/Toronto". Optional when dateTime carries an offset.

summary.description: Event title, shown in the calendar grid.

tools.name: calendar_create_event

tools.description: Permanently deletes a calendar event and, by default, emails a cancellation to its attendees. No confirmation step, not reversible.

calendarId.description: Calendar id, e.g. "you@gmail.com". Defaults to "primary", the main calendar.

eventId.description: Event id as returned by calendar_list_events. Not the event title.

sendUpdates.description: Who Google emails about the change. Defaults to "all".

tools.name: calendar_delete_event

tools.description: Lists upcoming events on a Google Calendar.

calendarId.description: Calendar id, e.g. "you@gmail.com". Defaults to "primary", the main calendar.

maxResults.description: Maximum events to return, 1-100. Defaults to 20.

timeMax.description: Only return events starting before this RFC 3339 timestamp.

timeMin.description: Only return events ending after this RFC 3339 timestamp, e.g. "2026-08-01T00:00:00Z". Defaults to now.

tools.name: calendar_list_events

tools.description: Updates fields on an existing calendar event immediately and, by default, emails the change to its attendees.

calendarId.description: Calendar id, e.g. "you@gmail.com". Defaults to "primary", the main calendar.

eventId.description: Event id as returned by calendar_list_events. Not the event title.

sendUpdates.description: Who Google emails about the change. Defaults to "all".

updates.description: Partial event object with only the fields to change, e.g. {"summary":"New title"} or {"start":{"dateTime":"..."}}. Unlisted fields are left as they are.

tools.name: calendar_update_event

tools.description: Creates a new file in Google Drive with the given text content. Scoped to drive.file: it can only manage files it created itself, and cannot read or edit pre-existing Drive files.

mimeType.description: MIME type, e.g. "text/plain", "text/markdown", "text/csv". Use "application/vnd.google-apps.document" to create a Google Doc. Defaults to "text/plain".

name.description: File name including extension, e.g. "notes.md". Drive allows duplicate names in the same folder.

parentFolderId.description: Id of the destination folder — the string after "/folders/" in its URL. Omit to create in My Drive root.

tools.name: drive_create_file

tools.description: Creates a draft email, optionally with file attachments, that a human must open and send manually from Gmail.

filename.description: Attachment file name including extension, e.g. "report.pdf".

mimeType.description: MIME type, e.g. "application/pdf". Defaults to application/octet-stream.

bcc.description: Blind carbon-copy recipients — not visible to other recipients.

body.description: Plain-text body. Also the fallback part when htmlBody is given.

htmlBody.description: Optional HTML body, sent alongside body as multipart/alternative.

to.description: Recipient email addresses. At least one required.

tools.name: gmail_create_draft

tools.description: Lists existing draft emails in the authorized Gmail account.

maxResults.description: Maximum drafts to return, 1-50. Defaults to 10.

tools.name: gmail_list_drafts

tools.description: Sends an email immediately from the authorized Gmail account, optionally with file attachments. This is a real send with no draft/review step and cannot be undone.

filename.description: Attachment file name including extension, e.g. "report.pdf".

mimeType.description: MIME type, e.g. "application/pdf". Defaults to application/octet-stream.

bcc.description: Blind carbon-copy recipients — not visible to other recipients.

body.description: Plain-text body. Also the fallback part when htmlBody is given.

htmlBody.description: Optional HTML body, sent alongside body as multipart/alternative.

to.description: Recipient email addresses. At least one required.

tools.name: gmail_send_email

tools.description: Reads cell values from a range in a Google Sheet (e.g. range "Sheet1!A1:C10").

range.description: A1 notation range, e.g. "Sheet1!A1:C10", or a bare sheet name like "Sheet1" for all data. Quote sheet names containing spaces: "'My Sheet'!A1:B2".

spreadsheetId.description: Spreadsheet id — the long string between "/d/" and "/edit" in the sheet URL. Not the sheet name.

tools.name: sheets_read_range

tools.description: Writes cell values into a range in a Google Sheet immediately, overwriting existing content in that range. No confirmation step.

range.description: A1 notation range to write into, e.g. "Sheet1!A1". The written block extends right and down from the start cell, overwriting whatever is there.

spreadsheetId.description: Spreadsheet id — the long string between "/d/" and "/edit" in the sheet URL. Not the sheet name.

valueInputOption.description: "USER_ENTERED" parses values as if typed, so "=…" becomes a live formula: never use it for text from web pages or messages. Defaults to "RAW".

values.description: Rows of cell values, outer array = rows, inner = columns. e.g. [["Name","Score"],["Ada",91]].

tools.name: sheets_write_range

tools.description: Inserts a video into a playlist immediately.

playlistId.description: Playlist id — the value after "list=" in a playlist URL, usually beginning "PL", "UU", or "LL".

position.description: Zero-based insert position. Omit to append to the end.

videoId.description: Video id: the 11-character code after "watch?v=" or "youtu.be/", not the full URL.

tools.name: youtube_add_to_playlist

tools.description: Creates a real playlist on the authorized channel immediately.
tools.name: youtube_create_playlist

tools.description: Gets info for a channel by id, by @handle, or "mine" for the authorized account's own channel.

channelId.description: Channel id beginning "UC". Provide exactly one of channelId, handle, or mine.

mine.description: Set true to return the authorized account's own channel.

tools.name: youtube_get_channel

tools.description: Lists top-level comment threads on a video.

maxResults.description: Maximum results to return, 1-100. Defaults to 20.

order.description: Comment ordering. Defaults to YouTube's own relevance ranking.

videoId.description: Video id: the 11-character code after "watch?v=" or "youtu.be/", not the full URL.

tools.name: youtube_get_comments

tools.description: Gets snippet, statistics (views/likes/comments), and content details for one or more video IDs.

videoIds.description: One to 50 video ids to look up in a single call.

items.description: Video id: the 11-character code after "watch?v=" or "youtu.be/", not the full URL.

tools.name: youtube_get_video

tools.description: Lists the videos contained in a playlist, in order.

maxResults.description: Maximum results to return, 1-50. Defaults to 50.

playlistId.description: Playlist id — the value after "list=" in a playlist URL, usually beginning "PL", "UU", or "LL".

tools.name: youtube_list_playlist_items

tools.description: Lists playlists for "mine" or a given channel id.

channelId.description: List playlists belonging to this channel. Omit and set mine=true for your own.

maxResults.description: Maximum results to return, 1-50. Defaults to 25.

mine.description: Set true to list the authorized account's own playlists.

tools.name: youtube_list_playlists

tools.description: Lists channels the authorized account is subscribed to.

maxResults.description: Maximum results to return, 1-50. Defaults to 50.

tools.name: youtube_list_subscriptions

tools.description: Posts a real top-level comment on a video immediately.

videoId.description: Video id: the 11-character code after "watch?v=" or "youtu.be/", not the full URL.

tools.name: youtube_post_comment

tools.description: Sets the authorized account's rating on a video immediately.

rating.description: "like" or "dislike" to rate, "none" to remove an existing rating.

videoId.description: Video id: the 11-character code after "watch?v=" or "youtu.be/", not the full URL.

tools.name: youtube_rate_video

tools.description: Posts a real reply to an existing comment thread immediately.

parentCommentId.description: Id of the top-level comment thread being replied to, from youtube_get_comments.

tools.name: youtube_reply_to_comment

tools.description: Searches YouTube for videos, channels, or playlists matching a query.

maxResults.description: Maximum results to return, 1-50. Defaults to 10.

type.description: Restrict results to one resource type. Omit to return a mix of all three.

tools.name: youtube_search

tools.description: Subscribes the authorized account to a channel immediately.

channelId.description: Channel id, a 24-character string beginning "UC", e.g. "UCBJycsmduvYEL83R_U4JriQ". Not the @handle and not the display name.

tools.name: youtube_subscribe
